features.name: is_lunch
features.definition: 1 if meal_type = LUNCH else 0 (breakfast is the reference category)

features.name: n_eligible_scaled
features.definition: number of eligible menu items / number of eligible slots

features.name: mean_carbon_score
features.definition: mean catalogue-normalised carbon score c_i over eligible items

features.name: carbon_spread
features.definition: max c_i - min c_i over eligible items (0 if fewer than 2)

features.name: pred_lowcarbon_share
features.definition: forecast share of eligible demand on items with c_i below the catalogue median, queried under neutral placement

features.name: recent_exposure
features.definition: mean realised D over the previous 9 deployed meals, all meal types (0 if none)

features.name: d
features.definition: D = -sum_i (v_i^a - v_i^0) * c_i over eligible items

features.name: m
features.definition: M = 0.5 * sum_i |v_i^a - v_i^0| over eligible items
